new_categories.label: hold_lighting_function_readiness
new_categories.memory: Delivered dry-cargo hold illumination readiness is a cargo-space service-state distinct from generic shipboard electrical-power availability.

new_categories.label: fixture_zone_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Lighting readiness can be localized to an affected hold, zone or bounded cargo-space scope without retaining exact fixture locations or lighting layouts.

new_categories.label: lighting_circuit_availability_confidence
new_categories.memory: Lighting-circuit availability can degrade separately from fixture condition and from upstream electrical-power availability without retaining circuit topology.

new_categories.label: power_support_confidence
new_categories.memory: Power-support confidence for hold lighting is distinct from delivered illumination and does not by itself establish that lighting is available in the cargo space.

new_categories.label: fixture_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: Physical fixture-condition confidence can be represented non-specifically without retaining fixture type, protection details, ratings or hazardous-area classification.

new_categories.label: local_control_interface_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-operational local control or switching-interface confidence state can be distinct from fixture, circuit and power-support readiness without retaining actual switch positions or operating steps.

new_categories.label: illumination_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Verification that useful illumination is present is distinct from electrical continuity or fixture existence and can degrade independently without retaining measured illumination levels.

new_categories.label: alternate_lighting_confidence
new_categories.memory: Alternate-lighting availability confidence can be retained abstractly without specifying portable-lighting arrangements, substitutions, setup actions or work procedures.

new_categories.label: cargo_work_availability_not_lighting_state_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Inspection, access or cargo-work availability is a downstream outcome and is not equivalent to fixture, circuit, support or illumination-verification state.

new_categories.label: hold_lighting_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: The lighting service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-verification and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to fixture function, zone scope, circuit availability, power support, control interface, illumination verification or alternate-lighting confidence.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Inspection uncertainty, cargo-work restriction, access limitation, port rework or schedule effects do not prove a fixture, circuit, power-support, control-interface or zone-scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_lighting_restoration
new_categories.memory: Fixture correction, circuit recovery, support recovery, control-interface return, illumination verification and cargo-space release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: generic_electrical_power_vs_delivered_hold_lighting
useful_refinements.memory: P070 generic shipboard electrical-power readiness may support lighting but does not establish delivered cargo-hold illumination.

useful_refinements.label: hatch_access_vs_hold_lighting
useful_refinements.memory: P086 hatch/access readiness establishes access-path service but does not establish internal hold illumination or lighting-zone coverage.

useful_refinements.label: cleanliness_inspection_vs_lighting
useful_refinements.memory: P109 cleanliness/inspection confidence can depend on visibility but does not establish the hold-lighting service itself.

useful_refinements.label: atmosphere_monitoring_vs_lighting
useful_refinements.memory: P110 atmosphere monitoring and its electrical/data supports do not establish hold-lighting circuit, fixture or illumination readiness.

duplicates.label: generic_delivered_service_vs_support_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic distinction between delivered service, upstream support and local interface repeats campaign-wide service-state mechanics.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_degradation_verification_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope localization, downstream-effect separation and verified-restoration mechanics are already campaign-wide.

reviewed_no_specific_memory: exact fixture types, locations, ratings, illumination levels or current configuration
exact lighting-circuit arrangements, protection devices, switching states or hazardous-area classifications
exact inspection, testing, temporary-lighting setup, cargo-space entry or work procedures
named lighting vendors, service contractors, ports, yards, incidents, deficiency findings or current-readiness facts
negative_space: exact cargo-hold lighting arrangements, fixture types/counts/locations/ratings, illumination levels, circuit topology, protection, hazardous-area classification and current configuration
exact switching, inspection, testing, temporary-lighting setup, cargo-space entry, cargo-work, troubleshooting or emergency procedures
named lighting-equipment vendors, service contractors, ports, yards, inspectors, incidents, deficiency findings and current readiness
private/regional cargo-hold lighting equipment/service lineages plus non-English predecessor terminology
stop_reason: The bounded structural questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact fixture arrangements, illumination levels, circuit/protection details, hazardous-area classification, test methods, entry/work procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo hold lighting/illumination service orientation and source-discovery output; not electrical switching, temporary-lighting, cargo-space entry or work guidance and not proof of any exact fixture arrangement, illumination level, circuit, classification, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
